stop_reason: Literal registry-lattice rule: a 37,654-dot raster has at least 82.34% of dots within 3 px of the registered spacing-5 lattice (counting bound, > 70% gate). Stop before placement.

pre_placement_count_bound.caveat: A counting bound against one registered lattice, not a proof about every raster. Below min_dots_for_forced_stop the count alone forces nothing. Exploiting that is a density change the repository forbids; flagged for owner review, not acted on.

same_bound_applied_to_highest_user_repor.note: The literal rule would stop the highest user-reported file too. Owner must decide which rule governs.

scope: Count-bound verification only. Holdout DTI not recomputed in this session; cited HOLDOUT-DTI figures belong to their original run cards.
